name: lavabalance
description: Custom autobalance bot for the Beyond All Reason lobby (Teiserver, legacy Spring protocol) running as a Cloudflare Worker + Durable Object.

scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy && echo 'Deployed. The cron restarts the bot within 5 min; check /bot/status, or once the rollout has settled force it with: pnpm run bot:kick'
scripts.bot:kick: curl -fsS --retry 6 --retry-delay 10 -X POST "${BOT_CONTROL_URL:-https://lavabalance.fogofwar.dev}/bot/restart" -H "authorization: Bearer $CONTROL_TOKEN" || { echo; echo "bot:kick FAILED — the Worker deployed but the bot was not restarted. Export CONTROL_TOKEN and run: pnpm run bot:kick"; exit 1; }
